seo.title: Infinity Yacht Galapagos: Cruises | James Wild & Co
seo.description: Royal Galapagos' Infinity: a 49-metre, 20-guest yacht with 2 suites, 8 balcony staterooms and 2 naturalist guides. 4, 5 and 8-day routes, 2026 and 2027 rates.

tagline: Twenty guests, a balcony in every cabin and two naturalist guides.
answer: Infinity is Royal Galapagos' 49-metre luxury yacht, built in 2018. She carries 20 guests in 2 suites and 8 staterooms, every one with a private balcony, with 12 crew, a cruise director and 2 bilingual naturalist guides. Routes run 4, 5 or 8 days between Baltra and San Cristobal. Royal Galapagos built her with families and small groups in mind, with interconnecting cabins.

overview: Infinity is a 49-metre yacht built in 2018 for Royal Galapagos, an Ecuadorian company running small yachts in the islands since 2012. Royal Galapagos says she was designed with families and small groups in mind.

She takes 20 guests. Six double staterooms on the Main Deck run from 25 to 26 square metres; the Upper Deck has two suites of 31 and 33 square metres and two more staterooms of 27 square metres. Every cabin has a private balcony, hot water and air conditioning, and Suite 8 connects to Cabin 10. There is a large dining room, a lounge, an upper deck bar, a sundeck jacuzzi and al fresco dining, with internet on board.

Week A sails from Baltra to San Cristobal via Genovesa, Santiago, Rabida, the Santa Cruz highlands, Floreana and Espanola. Week B returns via Santa Fe, South Plaza, western Isabela, Fernandina, Santiago and Bartolome. A 4-day section covers Genovesa and Santiago; a 5-day section covers Santa Cruz, Floreana and Espanola.
why: Two naturalist guides for 20 guests and the largest cabins in this set, from 25 square metres, each with a balcony.
Interconnecting cabins and a family brief from Royal Galapagos make her a strong fit for multi-generation groups, and the two 8-day weeks join into 15 days.

Royal Galapagos says Infinity was designed with families and small groups in mind and has interconnecting cabins.
faqs: How many guests does Infinity carry?
Twenty, in two suites and eight staterooms, with 12 crew, a cruise director and two bilingual naturalist guides.
Do all Infinity cabins have balconies?
Yes. Royal Galapagos says every suite and stateroom has a private balcony and panoramic windows.
Royal Galapagos says she was designed with families and small groups in mind. Suite 8 and Cabin 10 interconnect, and under 15s get 20% off when sharing with one full-paying adult.
Staterooms are 25 to 27 square metres and the two suites are 31 and 33 square metres, as published by Royal Galapagos.
How much does an Infinity cruise cost?
Royal Galapagos' 2027 rack rates are US$9,445 per person in a stateroom or US$11,045 in a suite for 8 days, and from US$3,945 for 4 days. Flights and park fees are extra.
Yes. A whole-yacht charter for 20 guests is US$169,450 for 8 days or US$71,450 for 4 days in 2027.
Week A visits Genovesa, Santiago, Rabida, Santa Cruz, Floreana and Espanola. Week B visits Santa Fe, South Plaza, western Isabela, Fernandina, Santiago and Bartolome.
All meals, island transfers, excursions, expedition gear, the naturalist guides and carbon offsetting. Flights, alcohol, the park fee, the transit card and tips are extra.
